review.why: Writes academic CVs that keep publication status, authorship order, funding and teaching roles exact.
review.summary: Builds or updates academic CVs for research, postdoc, faculty and teaching posts. A table lists the distinctions to preserve (degrees, appointments, publication status, author order, grants, teaching, mentoring, service) and the skill forbids invented DOIs, citation counts or acceptances.
strengths: Precise table of the distinctions an academic record must keep
Never invents bibliographic details; unchecked items are marked unverified
Explicit consent rules for students and referees
cautions: Instructions only: no templates or scripts
Narrow audience: academic appointments, not industry resumes
Mentions optional checks and saves through an account; the code for that is not included
